enrichment method: we performed co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) mass spectrometry analysis of EP300-binding proteins in SW1990 cells in the absence or presence of RSL3 treatment.
labeling: Proteins identified in the αEP300-IP group need to be excluded from those identified in the IgG-IP negative control group; (2) Proteins with at least 2 unique peptides; (3) Protein confidence score (-10lgP) greater than 70.
